description: SEPSTER estimates energetic-proton peak intensities near one astronomical unit. Its empirical formulation connects observed solar-event longitude and CME speed with multi-spacecraft particle measurements. The resource is documented by UMD and NASA GSFC. The documented physical domain is Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree), Continuous/RT Run (SEP Scoreboard Intensity). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The forecast is tied to the documented energy band and longitudinal event relationships. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
